title: Nested Loops
concept: Put a loop inside another loop to process multi-dimensional data like grids, tables, or combinations.
why: Many problems are inherently two-dimensional — game boards, multiplication tables, or checking every pair of items.
tips: Inner loop runs COMPLETELY for each single outer iteration
`break` only exits the innermost loop — plan accordingly
common_mistakes: Using the SAME variable name for both loops: `for i in ... for i in ...`
Thinking break exits ALL loops — it only exits one
Creating deeply nested loops (3+ levels) — hard to read and slow
